title: querylog.py close refuses a rules finding, so a rules miss the _self docs do not answer cannot be closed with --tried or --reject
goal: querylog.py close F-ID --tried NOTE and --reject accept an open rules finding whose question the _self docs do not answer, recording the note in its findings record, so the finding leaves the open list without an eval row or a doc edit

run: import re,shutil,subprocess,sys,tempfile; t=tempfile.mkdtemp(); d=t+'/store'; shutil.copytree('kb/_querylog', d); o=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/querylog.py','show','--findings','--kind','rules','--state','open','--store',d],capture_output=True,text=True).stdout; f=re.findall(r'^(F-\w+) rules',o,re.M); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/querylog.py','close',f[0],'--tried','kb lacks the answer','--store',d]).returncode)
